about.title: Mikey and Sara
paragraphs: Mikey's Gasoline Alley & Mobile Mechanics is run by Mikey and his wife Sara. Mikey brings the tools to you, or works on your car at the shop on E Street, by appointment.
You'll get updates along the way and a clear explanation of the problem before anything gets fixed.
about.photo_alt: Car with the hood up on the roadside

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and Mikey or Sara will get back to you. Or call (360) 281-8928 (Mon–Fri: 9am–5pm; Sat: 10am–2pm; By appointment).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Mikey or Sara will get back to you soon to set up a time.

services.name: Mobile Mechanic
services.blurb: Repairs at your home, work or roadside.
services.intro: Can't get to a shop? Mikey comes to you, rain or shine, and fixes it where it sits.
photos: Car with the hood up on the roadside

services.name: Diagnostics
services.blurb: Check engine lights and hard-to-find problems.
services.intro: Warning lights tracked down to the real cause, like corroded connections, often for far less than a dealer quote.
photos: Scan tool plugged into a car

services.name: Tune-Ups
services.blurb: Plugs, coils and a smoother running engine.
services.intro: Plugs, ignition coils, valve cover gaskets and more, done promptly for a reasonable price.
photos: Clean engine bay with the hood open
Gloved hand on an engine oil cap

services.name: Welding
services.intro: Mikey is a skilled welder and can handle challenging repairs that need more than a wrench.

services.name: Cooling Systems
services.intro: An overheating engine needs attention fast. We fix the cooling system before it causes bigger damage.
photos: Mechanic reaching into an engine bay

services.name: Shop Repairs
services.blurb: Everyday repairs on cars and trucks.
services.intro: From small fixes to bigger mechanical repairs, we work on everyday cars and trucks and explain what your vehicle needs before we start.
includes: Straight answers on what it needs
